title: Sumpter Extract Record Envelope
description: Validates one emitted extract record row (a single NDJSON line in records.jsonl). The envelope wraps the recipe-owned payload (extract.data) with runtime provenance (_runtime) and optional validation/summary blocks. The structural envelope (top-level keys, the extract block) is sumpter-owned and closed; the payload (extract.data), summaries, validation report, and _runtime provenance set are additively extensible. Rows self-identify via _runtime.envelope_schema so future contract mappings stay additive.

_runtime.description: Runtime provenance attached to every record. The required set is the always-emitted minimum; provenance fields are added when available and the object stays open for additive growth.

envelope_schema.description: Self-identifying envelope contract id. Major-only so additive minor schema revisions do not churn the per-row value.

source_file.description: Logical source identity (bare path, file:// URI, or s3:// URI) of the input that produced this record.

record_type.description: Recipe-declared record type for this stream.

record_num.description: 1-based pre-filter position of this record in its source document. Emitted only when the extraction path assigns it.

_validation.description: Optional validation report. Present only when validation metadata is enabled and surfaced. Shape is validation-owned and intentionally open here.

extract.description: The sumpter-owned extract block: the recipe payload plus optional summaries.

data.description: Recipe-owned extracted payload. Open by default; a strict mode (out of scope here) may validate it against the recipe output_schema.

summary.description: Optional recipe-declared summaries for this record.
